question:
The carpenter kept the furniture in backyard of his house. Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank.

 Desist

 Every Indian should ____ from acts of corruption.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Refrain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Desist"** means to stop doing something or to abstain from an action. (रोकना, परहेज करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The police asked the protesters to desist from blocking the road.
 
 
 
• **"Refrain"** means to hold back or abstain from doing something, particularly something you might be tempted to do. (परहेज करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Every citizen should refrain from acts of dishonesty and corruption.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Refrain" is the most appropriate synonym of "Desist" in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Refrain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Show** (दिखाना): To display or exhibit something.
 
 
• **Example:** He wanted to show his new painting to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Pledge** (प्रतिज्ञा): A solemn promise or commitment.
 
 
• **Example:** She pledged to support the charity for the next five years.
 
 
 
• **Insist** (ज़ोर देना): To demand something firmly or persistently.
 
 
• **Example:** He insisted on paying for the meal despite our objections.
 
 

Question: Every Indian should ____ from acts of corruption.
 

The correct answer is: **Refrain**.
